invariants.text: Unknown, stale, unsupported, contradictory, expired, or revoked authority never defaults to ALLOW.
Internal organization_id is the tenant-authority key; provider tenant identifiers are provenance only.
Human, agent, service, workload, and device principals are first-class.
Roles group bindings; role names are not magical authority.
Entitlement, product availability, membership, and runtime authority remain distinct.
External assertions may satisfy policy but never grant authority by themselves.
Capability, resource, effect, time, use, delegation, evidence, approval, risk, offline, and financial bounds narrow monotonically.
Money is parsed from canonical ASCII into exact typed units with registered asset and scale.
One bounded parse produces the semantic object used for evaluation, hashing, receipts, and envelopes.
Duplicate keys are rejected before JSON normalization or database JSONB ingestion.
Delegation traversal is branch-local, cycle-safe, bounded, cross-org explicit, and intersection-only.
Every mutable ALLOW dependency is revalidated or covered by a proven monotonic aggregate in finalization.
Consequential decisions finalize in the same transaction that assigns synchronization sequences, inserts the decision, and inserts its receipt.
Authority-invalidating mutations use the same global lock-class order and bump generations or epochs atomically.
Advisory locks do not participate in authority correctness.
Deferred and external effects obtain fresh effect-time authority.
A previous decision, approval, event, queue admission, token, or signature is not ambient authority.
Vault brokers credentials and cryptographic operations but is never an authority source.
Operational availability may stop admission but does not rewrite authority semantics.
Technical authority never implies legal ownership, office, employment, equity, or signature authority.
Production authority remains NONE until separately deployed, reviewed, and admitted.
